title: silene patula subsp. longicilia
intro: Silene patula subsp. longicilia, commonly known as Long-stalked Catchfly, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Silene patula subsp. longicilia include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may also contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
